narrative: MGX33-2013A-0367 tripped on DC GF. Traced the fault to a pinched connector in CB-B08-06 where the home run enters the can, the connector body had been trapped against the gland plate on install. Replaced the connector and dressed the run properly clear of the plate. Insulation resistance verified normal on the affected string before restoration. Unit back online and has held. Worth checking the other entries in this can at the next PM, they were all done by the same crew.
